gloss_en: "the Torah of the LORD" (torat HaShem) — in R. Nachman's reading of Avodah Zarah 19a on Psalms 1:2, the Torah as it belongs to God before one has labored in it: the hidden, not-yet-attained dimension of Torah (bechinat nistar, 'the hidden things belong to God'), corresponding to nishma ('we will hear'), as opposed to torato, 'his own Torah,' the revealed/naaseh portion
